format.description: Golden vectors for the RunBank contract (PRD §11.7). Replay each scenario against the contract and assert every field after every tick.
format.scenarios: name; level 0|1; config (BankConfig, decimal strings for amounts, numbers for bps and ticks); ledger "ledger.json" in this folder; ticks[]
format.setup: loadLedger(ledger.json), setLevel(level, config), fund cash0+bonds0, startRumor, then sealTicks one tick at a time (or batched) with ticks[i].requested

expect.cash: snapshot.cash after the tick (decimal string, base units)
expect.served: TickSummary.served = length of the PRD §9.4 `serve` list (includes ids trapped by a failure in this tick)
expect.status: snapshot.status after the tick: 0 Ready, 1 Running, 2 Failed, 3 Survived
expect.withdrawnCount: snapshot.withdrawnCount (who was actually paid; differs from the running sum of `served` after a mid-serve failure)

format.notes: A scenario ends at the first tick after which status != Running. `requested` is strictly ascending; [] is a quiet tick.
